tools.name: get_practice_score
tools.description: Look up a TuneViva score by its numeric ID. Returns title, score_url (the tuneviva.com score page), musicxml (a compressed MusicXML (MXL) download), url (the tuneviva.com practice page for the score) and a message about the files. tools.name: scan_sheet_music
tools.description: Get the link and instructions for recognising printed sheet music in the browser. Returns url, the tuneviva.com recognition page where the user picks a photo or PDF, and message, which explains that recognition runs locally and the output should be checked against the original. tools.name: search_sheet_music
tools.description: Build a TuneViva search link for a composer or piece. Returns url, the tuneviva.com search results page for the query, and message, a reminder to open the results and confirm title, composer and arrangement before choosing a score. The tool does not fetch or rank results itself.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_practice_score, scan_sheet_music, search_sheet_music · Private data: get_practice_score · Public sink: scan_sheet_music.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_practice_score, scan_sheet_music, search_sheet_music · Private data: get_practice_score · Public sink: scan_sheet_music

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_practice_score" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
